(Japanese: '''決戦！ロースト砂漠の戦い！！''' ''Decisive Battle! Battle in {{tt|Roast Desert|Asado Desert}}!!'') is the 25th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Scarlet & Violet}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

It is subtitled (Japanese: '''VS ツノワダチ 後編''' ''VS {{tt|Tetsunowadachi|Iron Treads}} Part Two'').

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}

==Major events==
* {{adv|Arven}}'s {{p|Shellder}} evolves into a {{p|Cloyster}}. 
* With help from [[Kofu]] and [[Saguaro]], {{Violet}} and Arven defeat {{p|Iron Treads}} and {{p|Great Tusk}} and find the [[Sour Herba Mystica]].
{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
